title: CmdPal: Shelf (3/n) - Add drag-and-drop support to the quick access shelf
author: jiripolasek
summary: Phase 0 passed and the upstream head and CI remain current, but the code review is not complete. Three fork-side correctness fixes were implemented and validated; the latest fresh Copilot review produced zero published comments and all threads are resolved, but an important round-three suppressed finding remains: DataPackageTransfer does not preserve the package resource map used by HTML content with referenced images.
